tableData.title: Q2FY27 Quarterly Result Announced for Tata Consultancy Services Ltd.
tableData.text: IT Consulting & Software company Tata Consultancy Services announced Q2FY27 results Consolidated Financial Highlights:  Revenue from Operations: Stood at Rs 73,188 crore in Q2FY27, registering a YoY growth of 11.23% compared to Rs 65,799 crore in Q2FY26. On a QoQ basis, revenue increased by 1.26% from Rs 72,275 crore in Q1FY27. Total Income: Reached Rs 74,525 crore in Q2FY27, reflecting an increase of 11.79% YoY from Rs 66,666 crore in Q2FY26, and a growth of 0.92% QoQ from Rs 73,843 crore in Q1FY27. Operating Income: Recorded at Rs 17,301 crore in Q2FY27, demonstrating a YoY growth of 13.81% against Rs 15,201 crore in Q2FY26, and a 5.65% QoQ increase from Rs 16,376 crore in Q1FY27. Net Profit (Profit for the period): Reported at Rs 13,934 crore in Q2FY27, showcasing a YoY growth of 14.86% from Rs 12,131 crore in Q2FY26. Sequentially, the net profit grew by 3.83% QoQ from Rs 13,420 crore in Q1FY27. The net profit for the entire FY26 was Rs 49,454 crore. Total Comprehensive Income: Stood at Rs 13,771 crore in Q2FY27, up 9.72% YoY compared to Rs 12,551 crore in Q2FY26, and a marginal QoQ rise of 0.72% from Rs 13,673 crore in Q1FY27. For FY26, it was Rs 52,204 crore.  Standalone Financial Highlights:  Revenue from Operations: Recorded at Rs 60,441 crore in Q2FY27, representing a YoY growth of 10.84% against Rs 54,531 crore in Q2FY26. On a QoQ basis, it grew by 1.49% from Rs 59,553 crore in Q1FY27. Total Income: Stood at Rs 63,490 crore in Q2FY27, marking an increase of 12.77% YoY from Rs 56,299 crore in Q2FY26, and a 0.84% QoQ growth from Rs 62,959 crore in Q1FY27. Net Profit (Profit for the period): Reached Rs 14,104 crore in Q2FY27, reflecting a robust YoY growth of 19.24% compared to Rs 11,828 crore in Q2FY26, and a 3.39% QoQ increase from Rs 13,642 crore in Q1FY27. Total Comprehensive Income: Stood at Rs 13,549 crore in Q2FY27, rising by 17.18% YoY from Rs 11,563 crore in Q2FY26, but declining slightly by 2.78% QoQ from Rs 13,937 crore in Q1FY27. For FY26, it was Rs 48,496 crore.  Business Highlights:  Q2 Total Contract Value (TCV): USD 9.6 billion Operating Margin at 24.0% Net Cash from Operations at Rs 14,190 crore i.e., 102.2% of Net Income Workforce strength: 598,056; LTM Attrition (IT Services): 13.3% Dividend per share: Rs 12 per share| Record date 14-Oct-2026 | Payment date 30-Oct-2026 Segment Revenue Performance:  Banking, Financial Services and Insurance: Rs 28,882 crore Manufacturing: Rs 7,346 crore Consumer Business: Rs 11,137 crore Communication, Media and Technology: Rs 10,862 crore Life Sciences and Healthcare: Rs 7,589 crore Others: Rs 7,372 crore   Strategic Acquisition: During Q2FY27, TCS Netherlands B.V. (a wholly owned subsidiary) signed a definitive agreement to acquire a 100% stake in MHP Management- und IT-Beratung GmbH and its subsidiaries ("MHP"). MHP is a leading automotive and industrial consulting firm, and the cash consideration was based on an enterprise value of EUR 320 million (equivalent to Rs 3,484 crore). Exceptional Items (Legal Settlement): The company reported an exceptional item consisting of a legal claim settlement relating to litigation with Computer Sciences Corporation amounting to Rs 668 crore in the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Corporate Restructuring: ListEngage Midco, LLC was renamed to Tata Consultancy Services (North America) Holdings, LLC with effect from July 2, 2026.  K Krithivasan, Chief Executive Officer & Managing Director, said: “We are pleased with the broad-based growth in all our international markets and most industry segments. This quarter we announced two unique deals with Porsche and Best Buy which represent a new category of transformation partnerships. Together with our clients, we are building repeatable value platforms that will industrialize AI at scale.“ Aarthi Subramanian, Executive Director, President & Chief Operating Officer, said: “AI momentum remained strong, with annualized AI revenues now exceeding USD3 billion. Demand for delivering business outcomes with AI-native solutions, AI-led transformation of enterprise systems and autonomous GBS, continues to accelerate. Cybersecurity remains a top priority as customers sharpen their focus on resilience and recovery. TCS’ Human+AI Services Autonomy model for AMS earned top rankings from customers, underscoring the strength of our differentiated capabilities.” Samir Seksaria, Chief Financial Officer, said: “We continued to strengthen our capabilities through acquisitions, partnerships and investments in niche talent. In addition, we maintained strong cash conversion and industry-leading profitability, along with our focus on creating sustainable long-term value for all stakeholders.” Sudeep Kunnumal, Chief HR Officer, said: “We continue to build a future-ready workforce through upskilling our employees and hiring top talent. Investments in learning and critical skills drove a 17% sequential increase in learning hours to 17.1 million. This quarter our employee base reached over 598,000, while attrition remained stable at 13.3%.” Result PDF

companyProfileData.companyDescription:
## About the company - Business Profile
Tata Consultancy Services Ltd. (TCS) is a global leader in IT services, consulting, and business solutions, operating as the flagship company of the Tata Group. As one of the world's largest IT services providers, TCS serves as a strategic digital transformation partner for enterprises across diverse industries, including banking, retail, and manufacturing. The company leverages its extensive domain expertise and global delivery model to offer a comprehensive suite of services ranging from infrastructure management to advanced AI and cloud-based solutions.

### Key Points

*   **Key Facts:** Founded in 1968 and headquartered in Mumbai, TCS is a subsidiary of Tata Sons. It is listed on the BSE and NSE and has grown into a global entity with operations in **55 countries**.
*   **Operations and Resources:** TCS operates through over **200 service delivery centers** worldwide. The company has a significant physical footprint and a robust digital infrastructure, including the recently launched **HyperVault AI Data Centers** and **TCS Sovereign Cloud**.
*   **Ownership:** As of the latest reports, TCS remains a key part of the Tata Group, with Tata Sons holding a majority stake. The company has a long history of maintaining strong corporate governance and returning value to shareholders through dividends and buybacks.
*   **Market and Significance:** TCS is critical to global supply chains and financial systems; for instance, **TCS BaNCS** powers major banking operations globally. It serves **54 of the Fortune 60** companies and has maintained the number one spot in customer satisfaction in Europe for 12 consecutive years.
*   **Sustainability and Innovation:** The company is committed to achieving net-zero emissions and has integrated sustainability into its core offerings. Innovation is driven through **TCS AI WisdomNext**, a platform designed to help enterprises adopt GenAI at scale.

**Business Model and Core Competencies**
TCS follows a "Building on Belief" philosophy, focusing on long-term client relationships and a "full-stack" service approach. It excels in execution at scale, domain-specific contextual knowledge, and a disciplined financial model that prioritizes industry-leading margins and return on equity (ROE).

**Revenue Breakdown (FY 2025 Consolidated)**
| Segment | Revenue (₹ Crore) | YoY Growth |
| :--- | :---: | :---: |
| Banking, Financial Services and Insurance (BFSI) | 94,597 | 4.0% |
| Communication, Media and Technology | 45,893 | 16.5% |
| Consumer Business | 40,197 | 2.1% |
| Life Sciences and Healthcare | 26,456 | -1.1% |
| Manufacturing | 25,170 | 7.1% |
| Others | 23,011 | 9.7% |
| **Total Revenue** | **2,55,324** | **6.0%** |

**Geographical Revenue (FY 2025)**
*   **North America:** 48.2%
*   **United Kingdom:** 16.8%
*   **Continental Europe:** 14.3%
*   **India:** Significant contributor with projects like the BSNL 4G/5G rollout.

**Key Products and Technology Advancements**
*   **TCS AI WisdomNext:** An industry-first platform that aggregates multiple Generative AI services to help enterprises choose and deploy the right models.
*   **TCS BaNCS:** A premier core banking software suite used by financial institutions globally.
*   **HyperVault:** Specialized AI Data Center services designed to handle intensive computational workloads.
*   **TCS ADD:** An advanced platform for drug development in the life sciences sector.
*   **GenAI Training:** Over **180,000 employees** have been trained in high-order AI skills to support more than **5,000 AI engagements**.

**Human Capital**
*   **Employee Count:** Over **607,000** associates globally as of March 2025.
*   **Hiring and Attrition:** TCS is known for its "entry-level talent" model, although recent years have seen increased focus on upskilling existing staff in AI/ML. Attrition rates have stabilized in FY 2025 following post-pandemic highs.

**Subsidiaries and Strategic Initiatives**
*   **Major Subsidiaries:** TCS has numerous global subsidiaries, including **TCS North America Corporation** and recent acquisitions like **ListEngage** and **Coastal Cloud** to bolster its Salesforce and cloud capabilities.
*   **Strategic Initiatives:** Current focus is on becoming an "AI-first" enterprise. This includes shifting from traditional digital transformation to AI-driven intelligence across the full tech stack—from infrastructure to applications.
*   **Future Outlook:** Despite global macroeconomic headwinds and longer decision cycles, TCS is positioning itself to capture demand in cloud migration, cybersecurity, and sovereign AI infrastructure.
